STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 13/R&A Dated: 16th March, 2026
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No.09/R&A dated 19th February, 2026, it is hereby
informed that due to some unavoidable circumstances, the interview scheduled on 16th & 17th
March, 2026 under Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 has been postponed and the
same shall now be held in the following manner:
Sl.No. Old date of
Interview
Rescheduled date of
Interview
1. 16.03.2026 30.03.2026
2. 17.03.2026 31.03.2026
Intimation in this regard is also being sent on the registered e-mail ID of respective
candidates.
Candidates will not be issued any separate Admit Card and will be granted admission
in the premises of the Court on their rescheduled date of interview on the basis of already issued
Admit Card.
There is no change in the interview schedule of 18th & 19th March, 2026.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s official website i.e.
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments regularly for further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
